items.quote: Torsa Dovake took ownership of service-level targets for frontline operations and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Torsa Dovake led keeping programme spending within the approved envelope across the department.
Direct reports said that Torsa drove change management after the merger of two units for the whole division.
Torsa was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of the rethink of subsidy rules for elderly households.
Torsa Dovake spearheaded explaining the new scheme on radio and at town halls at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Torsa Dovake championed steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Torsa drove accountability arrangements for public funds for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Torsa took ownership of the overnight response when the haze situation escalated and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Torsa Dovake took ownership of capability building for new hires and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Torsa supported senior colleagues on mapping interdependencies across agencies.
